title: 第19章 谁先动的手第20章 要被开除了
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
第19章谁先动的手
一辆库里南快速的奔驰而来，直到在校区才降低了速度。
原本就是放学的时间段，看到一辆豪车停在校门口处，不少学生都在盯着豪车，偷偷的谈论着。
“哇塞，好阔气的车啊。”
“劳斯莱斯啊，我的妈，这是谁家的车啊？”
“没想到我们学校还有这么有钱的人吗？”
“也不稀奇吧，校董他们的车也不差啊。”
郁景打开车门走下去后，第一时间便是将后车门打开。
郁凡从车上走了下来。
“爷爷，郁凌在高一的教务主任办公室，我先问问在地方。”
郁凌进入这所学校后，也就开学的时候他爸妈送过来过一次，他那时候工作忙也没时间来看下他弟的学校，现在一个电话，只告诉他办公室，他还真有些摸不着头脑。
“不用，跟我走。”扫了一眼，神识快速的锁定在办公室的郁凌，看到那鼻青脸肿的样子，郁凡忍不住摇了摇头，啧，被打成这样，真不像他的孙子。
一定是像自己儿子！
郁凡边走便观察着学校的整体环境，忍不住皱眉，总觉得和他在电视所看到的学校环境不太一样。
最近为了能跟上时代，郁凡偶尔也会看看电视，还曾感叹过现在学生的幸福，想他们那个年代，都是带上米粮走上个十多公里的泥巴路，破旧的土房里随意的摆着几张桌子就可以学习了。
哪像现在的孩子，高大的教学楼，宽敞明亮的教室，食堂里还有着丰盛的饭菜。
还好郁景不清楚郁凡心中所想，不然一定会吐槽爷爷看的那些奇奇怪怪的校园爱情电视剧。
他接到郁凌的电话，便知道郁凌肯定是惹了麻烦了，想着自己过来便是，谁知道自己和郁凌的电话，却被他爷爷给听到了。
郁凡知道自己孙子被老师留了下来，还要叫家长，那怎么行，立马要求自己过来。
郁景没办法，他也不敢跟他爷爷顶嘴，只好乖乖的给他爷爷当司机了。

没一会儿便到了教务主任处，站在门外都能听到主任在训斥孩子们的声音。
重点都是在郁凌身上，郁凌都没心思再给自己辩解了，他现在只希望他哥赶紧来解救他。
郁景敲了敲办公室门，教务主任这才看到站在门口的人。
郁凌看到他爷爷也来了，整个人都傻了，完蛋了，爷爷怎么也来了。
一看到郁凌居然叫了两个年轻人过来，主任便皱起了眉头。
“你们是郁凌的家长？”
郁景看了看站在角落的郁凌，点了点头。
“你们两个是他哥哥吧？不知道你们家到底是怎么教育孩子的，居然敢在学校打架，我建议你们先把他带回去好好管教一下。”
“老师，请问打架这件事情究竟是怎么发生的呢？”郁凡微笑着问。
他虽然笑得温和，可教务主任对上那双黑沉的眸子时还是忍不住打了个冷颤，这人看上去有点凶...
content_en:
Chapter 19 Who makes the first move?
A Cullinan came quickly and did not slow down until it reached the campus.
It was originally the time when school was over. I saw a luxury car parked at the school gate. Many students were staring at the luxury car and talking secretly.
"Wow, what a luxurious car."
"Rolls-Royce, my mother, whose car is this?"
"Did you never expect that there are such rich people in our school?"
"It's not surprising. The school director's car is not bad either."
After Yu Jing opened the car door and walked out, the first thing he did was open the rear door.
Yu Fan got out of the car.
"Grandpa, Yu Ling is in the office of the academic director of the first year of high school. I'll ask where he is first."
After Yu Ling entered this school, his parents sent him there once at the beginning of the school year. He was busy with work and didn't have time to visit his brother's school. Now that a phone call only told him about the office, he was really confused.
"No, come with me." He glanced at Yu Ling and quickly locked his consciousness on Yu Ling in the office. Seeing the bruised nose and swollen face, Yu Fan couldn't help but shook his head, "Tsk, being beaten like this really doesn't look like his grandson."
He must be like his own son!
As Yu Fan walked, he observed the overall environment of the school and couldn't help but frown. He always felt that the school environment was different from what he saw on TV.
Recently, in order to keep up with the times, Yu Fan occasionally watches TV. He also lamented the happiness of today's students. He recalled that in their time, they would walk more than ten kilometers of mud roads with rice and grain, and study with a few tables randomly placed in a dilapidated mud house.
It's not like today's children, with tall teaching buildings, spacious and bright classrooms, and sumptuous meals in the cafeteria.
Fortunately, Yu Jing didn't know what Yu Fan was thinking, otherwise he would have complained about those weird campus love TV dramas that his grandfather watched.
When he received a call from Yu Ling, he knew that Yu Ling must be in trouble. He thought that he would come over, but who knew that his grandfather heard the call between him and Yu Ling.
Yu Fan knew that his grandson had been kept by the teacher and wanted to call the parents. How could that be done? He immediately asked him to come over.
Yu Jing had no choice but to dare to talk back to his grandfather, so he had no choice but to act as his grandfather's driver.
After a while, we arrived at the dean's office. Standing outside the door, we could hear the dean's voice scolding the children.
The focus is all on Yu Ling, and Yu Ling doesn't have the heart to defend himself anymore. He just hopes that his brother will come to rescue him quickly.
Yu Jing knocked on the office door, and then the academic director saw the person standing at the door.
When Yu Ling saw that his grandpa was coming, he was stunned. It was all over, why was grandpa here too?
The director frowned when he saw that Yu Ling actually called two young people over.
"Are you Yu Ling's parents?"
Yu Jing looked at Yu Ling standing in the corner and nodded.
"You two are his brothers, right? I don't know how your family educates their children. How dare you fight in school? I suggest you take him back and discipline him properly."
"Teacher, how did this fight happen?" Yu Fan asked with a smile.
Although he smiled gently, the dean couldn't help but shudder when he met those dark eyes. This man looked a bit fierce...
